answer: Filling 47 aliases therefore needs 47 distinct prompts, so the operator pays the authoring cost per identity and cannot amortise one lookup. Because the mesa index is updated at intake, a repeated commitment is a duplicate by construction, and the dune audit republishes the digest set at close. Each answer commits to a prompt that differs from every prompt already used this epoch, checked against a cedar index of commitments rather than against the text alone. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
